plan.title: Treated vs control muscle DE on log2 expression (limma-trend)
plan.analytical_narrative: The core facility delivered log2(TPM+1) normalized expression (12000 genes x 12 samples: 6 treated, 6 control, muscle tissue, single batch, unpaired) rather than raw counts, so a count-based model (DESeq2/edgeR) is inapplicable per the knowledge service's rule R-0019: log-scale values require limma-trend, not a negative-binomial count model. The plan is: (1) QC sample structure on the log2 matrix as delivered (PCA/MDS, sample distances, detected genes per sample) to check for outliers and confirm treated/control separation before modeling; (2) filter low-abundance genes by mean log expression with a floor independent of group labels; (3) confirm no further normalization is needed (values are already log2(TPM+1), so only a range sanity check is performed, per R-0074); (4) fit a limma linear model (~0 + condition) with an explicit reference level and named contrast (treated - control), moderated t-statistics via eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) per R-0093/R-0019; (5) extract results via topTable with BH-adjusted p-values (R-0043/R-0044), reporting genes at padj < 0.05; (6) map result gene identifiers (symbol/Ensembl/Entrez) using the human organism annotation package, with an HPA-based muscle-tissue expression sanity check on top expressed genes per R-0161; (7) run camera competitive gene set testing on the limma fit against WikiPathways human pathway gene sets (the pathway reference actually available in this environment) since fgsea preranked GSEA is forbidden for this design by the knowledge service and camera is the permitted alternative; (8) produce a final report with design, thresholds, package versions, n tested/n DE genes, and session info. No batch correction is needed (single batch), and no fold-change threshold was requested by the user, so the standard BH-adjusted-p threshold is used without a TREAT effect-size test.
